description: Hytool is a MATLAB toolbox for interpreting hydraulic tests in groundwater wells. It provides analytical flow solutions for several aquifer types, diagnostic plots, data import and parameter fitting. The JOSS article describes uses in groundwater modelling and estimating inflows into tunnels; the own README identifies the current toolbox and MIT licence. Spatial coverage is the tested well and aquifer setting, and temporal coverage is the observation and fitted response period. Estimated transmissivity and storage can help parameterize groundwater-supply or tunnel-inflow simulations. A caveat is that a fitted analytical solution depends on aquifer assumptions, well construction and test quality. A site test does not characterize a whole catchment. MATLAB is a separate runtime requirement even though the toolbox code is open. No directly related catalogue record was established. The article and own repository were read without fitting test data or opening the repository manual PDF.
name: Hytool hydraulic test analysis
